apollo-to-cargo 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Introduces a tool to compare Apollo and Cargo list enrichment, measuring costs and hit rates on the same sample data.
- Provides setup and usage instructions for the Cargo CLI, with Apollo as one provider in the Cargo stack.
- Guides users to sample and compare a subset of records (10–20), avoiding full-list migrations initially.
- Lists credit costs for each enrichment action and warns against quoting savings without measurement.
- Outlines how to request user endorsement via GitHub stars only after successful use.
